% Documentation
%https://mirror.accum.se/mirror/CTAN/macros/latex/contrib/changes/changes.english.withcode.pdf
\usepackage[commandnameprefix=ifneeded]{changes} % use `final` to hide all markers
\usepackage{soul}
%\sethighlightmarkup{\IfIsColored{{\sethlcolor{authorcolor!30}\hl{#1}}}{#1}}
\setdeletedmarkup{} % Hide deleted parts from \deleted and \replaced
% ---- PATCH START ----
% This patch provides a partial fix to compilation errors when a \cite or \autoref is in a \deleted or \replaced block.
% The patch may cause line overflow.
% Code is generated by ChatGPT after pointing out the real cause of the issue.
% https://gitlab.com/ekleinod/changes/-/issues/46

% Set these to true to use \chdeleted/\chreplaced instead of \deleted/\replaced
\newif\ifusechdeleted
%\usechdeletedtrue    % ← uncomment to use \chdeleted
\newif\ifusechreplaced
%\usechreplacedetrue % ← uncomment to use \chreplaced

\newif\ifinchanges
% Save originals
\let\origcite\cite
\let\origautoref\autoref
\let\origdeleted\deleted
\let\origreplaced\replaced
\ifdefined\chdeleted\let\origchdeleted\chdeleted\fi
\ifdefined\chreplaced\let\origchreplaced\chreplaced\fi
% Patch \cite
\renewcommand{\cite}[2][]{%
  \ifinchanges
    \mbox{%
      \if\relax\detokenize{#1}\relax
        \origcite{#2}%
      \else
        \origcite[#1]{#2}%
      \fi
    }%
  \else
    \if\relax\detokenize{#1}\relax
      \origcite{#2}%
    \else
      \origcite[#1]{#2}%
    \fi
  \fi
}
% Patch \autoref
\renewcommand{\autoref}[1]{%
  \ifinchanges
    \mbox{\origautoref{#1}}%
  \else
    \origautoref{#1}%
  \fi
}
% Patch \deleted
\renewcommand{\deleted}[1]{%
  \inchangestrue%
  \origdeleted{#1}%
  \inchangesfalse%
}
% Patch \chdeleted
\ifdefined\chdeleted
\renewcommand{\chdeleted}[1]{%
  \inchangestrue%
  \origchdeleted{#1}%
  \inchangesfalse%
}
\fi
% Patch \replaced
\renewcommand{\replaced}[2]{%
  \inchangestrue%
  \ifusechreplaced
    \origchreplaced{#1}{#2}%
  \else
    \origreplaced{#1}{#2}%
  \fi
  \inchangesfalse%
}
% Patch \chreplaced
\ifdefined\chreplaced
\renewcommand{\chreplaced}[2]{%
  \inchangestrue%
  \origchreplaced{#1}{#2}%
  \inchangesfalse%
}
\fi
% ---- PATCH END ----
\definechangesauthor[color=BrickRed]{M24}
